title: 第9章 第七颗星子第10章 释放雷印
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: “4颗了，5颗一起把控，难度更大了啊，唉，不知道这学期结束前能不能完成把这7个小混蛋全部把控住，连成星轨来……话说起来，猴子说他现在每个星期最多只能够练习1个小时的把控，多个5分钟就得崩溃，也不知道为什么我一开始就可以练习2个小时，难不成是觉醒双系的原故？”莫凡自言自语的说道。
“把控一次星子蓝耗应该是一样的，也就是说我的蓝量比猴子他们要多一倍？”
每个魔法学生精神力都有限，每尝试着去把控一次星子，对精神都是一次损耗，以现在魔法学生们的精神力水准，貌似绝大多数人都只能够练习把控1个小时……
凭空多出了1个小时的优势，再加上莫凡每天的努力，他的进度已经超越同伴同学很多了，哪怕是班级里最为出色的慕白听他的狗腿子说他也不过是把控了3颗星子。
7颗才秀成正果，莫凡已经把控了4颗，并且有望在这个星期内突破5颗，看来觉醒双系提供给莫凡的不仅仅是可以开双号，连反沉迷时间都比别人长了！
这可是完美的优势啊！！
自己走上人生巅峰、迎娶白富美指日可待！
八点准上课，第一节是妖魔课，负责教妖魔课程的老师正是隔壁班的班主任张建国。
“莫凡，你怎么又迟到，就不能态度端正一点吗，你本来就天赋不如绝大多数同学，底子又特别差劲，还学得这么不认真，你看看我们班的照庭同学，天赋雷系，天资聪颖，底子好，学魔法态度又好，别人现在已经可以把控4颗雷系星子，而你呢，我听说你火系星子至今还不会把控，火系的觉醒在你身上都要浪费了！”张建国一看到莫凡姗姗来迟，马上毫不客气的训斥了起来。
莫凡不由的翻起了白眼，张建国老师真尼玛没完没了，几乎每节课都要提一下那个雷系的家伙。
那所谓的照庭同学正是那位在开学典礼上觉醒了雷霆系的小子，张建国每天都要挂嘴边，纵然一副教育别人的表情脸上也会流露出那掩饰不住的得意。
“那家伙把控4颗星子了吗，老子已经6颗就差最后一步了。”莫凡暗暗不屑，却也没有道出来，只是优哉游哉的走到了自己座位。
“好，大家打开妖魔之书，今天我将继续给大家讲述比较常见的妖魔。众所周知，妖魔分布在我们人类栖息的城市之外，对人类拥有绝对的攻击性，它们四处游荡，相互厮杀……那么一旦有魔法师要踏入野外，遇到一只独眼魔狼时该怎么做呢？”张建国已经开始眉飞色舞的讲述着课程。
独眼魔狼。
这是栖息在离人类城市最近荒野区域的一种妖魔，莫凡只通过书签和视频看到过大致模样，很凶残的样子。
普通人是无法对付这种生物的，唯有魔法师才可以和它们战斗，当然，对于至今还无法释放任何一个技能的这群魔法学生们来说，一旦出现只独眼魔狼那就是一场血腥屠杀！
独眼魔狼是妖魔课上讲述的重点，张建国已经花了一个星期在将这种妖魔了，莫凡听得都烦了。
现在，莫凡凭借着自己独有的双倍时间修炼已经将雷霆系星子掌控到6颗了，只要自己绝对集中精神便可以让那6颗星子乖乖的排列成星轨。
问题是，第七颗星子格外不好搞定，宛如一个贞洁烈女，软的不吃，硬的不从，让莫凡格外的捉急！
就tm差这一步了啊！！
“凡哥，火系的修炼你进度怎么样了啊？”张候见莫凡坐下来，急忙问了一句。
“老样子。”莫凡随意的回答道。
火系……
content_en:
"It's 4. It's even more difficult to control 5 together. Alas, I don't know if I can control all 7 little bastards before the end of this semester and connect them into a star track... Speaking of which, Monkey said that he can only practice control for 1 hour at most every week. If it takes more than 5 minutes, he will collapse. I don't know why I can practice for 2 hours at the beginning. Is it because of the awakening of dual systems?" Mo Fan said to himself.
"The mana consumption of controlling a star should be the same. In other words, my mana amount is twice as much as that of the monkeys?"
Every magic student has limited mental power. Every time he tries to control a star, it is a mental drain. With the current level of mental power among magic students, it seems that most of them can only practice controlling it for one hour...
With the advantage of an extra hour out of thin air, coupled with Mo Fan's daily efforts, his progress has surpassed his classmates by a lot. Even Mu Bai, the most outstanding person in the class, heard from his loser that he only controlled 3 stars.
It takes 7 stars to show off, but Mo Fan has already controlled 4, and is expected to break through 5 within this week. It seems that the awakening dual system provides Mo Fan not only the ability to open double accounts, but also the anti-addiction time is longer than others!
This is a perfect advantage! !
It's just around the corner to reach the pinnacle of your life and marry Bai Fumei!
…
…
Class starts at eight o'clock on time. The first period is the monster class. The teacher in charge of teaching the monster class is Zhang Jianguo, the head teacher of the next class.
"Mo Fan, why are you late again? Can't you have a better attitude? Your talent is not as good as that of most of your classmates, and your foundation is particularly bad, and you still don't study seriously. Look at Zhao Ting, a classmate in our class. He is talented in the thunder system, smart, and has a good foundation. He studies magic. You have a good attitude, others can already control the 4 thunder element stars, but as for you, I heard that you still can’t control the fire element stars, and the awakening of the fire element will be wasted on you!" When Zhang Jianguo saw Mo Fan arriving late, he immediately scolded him rudely.
Mo Fan couldn't help but roll his eyes. Teacher Zhang Jianguo was so crazy that he mentioned that thunder guy in almost every class.
The so-called Zhao Ting classmate was the boy who awakened the thunder element at the opening ceremony. Zhang Jianguo talked about it every day, and even if he looked like he was educating others, his face would show the pride that he couldn't hide.
"Has that guy controlled 4 stars? I already have 6 and am just short of the last step." Mo Fan was secretly disdainful, but did not say it out loud. He just walked to his seat leisurely.
"Okay, everyone, open the book of demons. Today I will continue to tell you about the more common demons. As we all know, demons are distributed outside the cities where we humans live, and they are absolutely aggressive to humans. They wander around and fight with each other... So what should a magician do when he steps into the wild and encounters a one-eyed demon wolf?" Zhang Jianguo has already begun to talk about the course with excitement.
One-eyed demon wolf.
This is a kind of monster that lives in the wilderness area closest to human cities. Mo Fan has only seen its general appearance through bookmarks and videos. It looks very ferocious.
Ordinary people cannot deal with such creatures. Only magicians can fight them. Of course, for this group of magic students who have not been able to release any skills so far, once a one-eyed magic wolf appears, it will be a bloody massacre!
The one-eyed demon wolf is the focus of the demon class. Zhang Jianguo has spent a week talking about this demon, and Mo Fan is tired of listening to it.
Now, Mo Fan has used his unique double time practice to control 6 thunder-type stars. As long as he concentrates absolutely, he can make the 6 stars arrange themselves into star trails.
The problem is that the seventh star is particularly difficult to deal with. Like a chaste and fierce woman, she refuses to eat the soft ones and refuses to obey the hard ones, which makes Mo Fan particularly anxious!
This is just one step away! !
"Brother Fan, how is your progress in training in the fire element?" Zhang Hou asked hurriedly when he saw Mo Fan sitting down.
"Same as before." Mo Fan replied casually.
Fire element...
